name: Saye
background: Saye walks from inn to inn telling old tales for a bed and a supper, and has not stayed anywhere longer than a week in years.
temperament: Moody and easily offended when ignored, charming when listened to; craves an audience.
speech: Theatrical, rich in old sayings, lowers her voice before the important part.
quirks: Collects buttons from people she likes; quotes ballads at the wrong moment; sulks visibly.
secret: Her best tales are not old at all: she invents them, and once got a man hanged with one.
goal: Find a cosy seat and gather a crowd willing to listen, talk with anyone who will talk back, and collect a new story to tell elsewhere.
